import json

# New alphabet: English order with 'c' and 'm' moved to the end (c second-to-last, m last).
order = "abdefghijklnopqrstuvwxyz" + "cm"
rank = {ch: i for i, ch in enumerate(order)}

words = [
    "medea", "oversimplifications", "clonic", "chaplin", "kennan", "postpone",
    "squabble", "ipsilateral", "misunderstandings", "ussr", "canal",
    "modifications", "referring", "counterrevolutionaries", "pyridine",
    "cameroon", "avalanche", "rationalizations", "fortran", "cram", "coachman",
]

# Every letter must exist in the new alphabet, otherwise sorting is undefined.
assert len(order) == 26 and len(set(order)) == 26
assert all(ch in rank for w in words for ch in w)

sorted_words = sorted(words, key=lambda w: [rank[ch] for ch in w])

result = {
    "final_answer": ", ".join(sorted_words),
    "evidence": {
        "alphabet": order,
        "word_count": len(words),
        "sorted_count": len(sorted_words),
        "first_word": sorted_words[0],
        "last_word": sorted_words[-1],
    },
}

print(json.dumps(result))
